title: Google's Scam Detection feature is headed to another Android device maker
description: Google's Scam Detection can warn you of potential scams during phone calls, and so far it's been available for Pixels of course, but also Samsung flagships since the Galaxy S26 series. However, it turns out that the feature is probably headed to a third Android brand: vivo. According to a new report based on a teardown of the latest Phone by Google app, vivo phones should be next in line to support Scam Detection. In the screenshots below, note that "Sharpie" is an internal codename Google has for the Scam Detection feature. Google Scam Detection headed to vivo phones There's...

title: vivo V80 Lite 5G teaser image shows part of its front design
description: Earlier this month we heard that vivo was working on the V80 Lite 5G, and its listing on the Google Play Console revealed that it's most likely a rebranded vivo S2. Today on Instagram the image you can see below was posted by a multi-brand mobile store in Shajapur, India. It shows a little bit of the device's front design, though the image seems to be heavily embellished, so to speak. The screen is clearly curved, that's for sure, and there's a hole punch cutout for the selfie camera in the center. The V80 Lite 5G's slogan could be "slay every edge", as the image reveals. title: HMD 102 4G Pro specs leak
description: HMD launched the 102 4G back in September of last year and now the company seems to be working on an upgraded version called the 102 4G Pro. This has been leaked today by a usually reliable source of HMD-related information. According to said source, the new device will have a 2" QQVGA LCD screen, a 0.3MP camera, the Unisoc 8910FF-S chipset, 24MB of RAM, 48MB of internal storage, support for 32GB microSD cards, and a 1,200 mAh battery which charges via USB-C. The phone will be IP52 certified for dust and rain resistance, and it will have Bluetooth 4.2, a 3.5mm headphone jack, and...

title: Motorola Edge 70 Max in for review
description: This is the Motorola Edge 70 Max, which launched last month. Let's take a look inside it box and see what it's about. The Edge 70 Max ships with 256GB of storage and either 8GB or 12GB of RAM. You can get it in Pantone Aqua Gray, Pantone Ice Melt, and Pantone Dark Shadow (our model), each with a unique-feeling texture. Prices are €750, £700, or INR 59,999. Unboxing the Motorola Edge 70 Max You get the usual cable and case in the box. The case isn't MagSafe-compatible, which is a shame, as we've seen lower-tier Motos with a MagSafe case in the box. description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is coming soon, having been already certified by the FCC and starred in multiple leaks recently. It may be unveiled in early September alongside the new Galaxy Tab S12 tablets. Ahead of that, a user on X has uploaded what he claims is a hands-on video of the Galaxy S26 FE. title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max with 10,000mAh battery to launch next week
description: Xiaomi has officially announced the launch of the new Redmi Note 17 Pro Max in global markets and also revealed some of its key specs. One of the phone's biggest highlights is its 10,000mAh battery. The company has set up a teaser page on its global website, confirming that the Redmi Note 17 series, including the new Note 17 Pro Max, will be unveiled on August 27. According to the official page, the handset will pack a 10,000mAh battery with 100W wired fast charging support. The Redmi Note 17 Pro Max is also confirmed to come with a 6.83-inch AMOLED display with a 1.5K...

title: Xiaomi Redmi Watch 6 Lite and Redmi Watch 6 Active leak again with specs and pricing
description: The Xiaomi Redmi Watch 6 Active and the Redmi Watch 6 Lite have leaked yet again – this time they broke cover as they surfaced on a price tracking site in Hungary. The Redmi Watch 6 Lite has a rectangular 1.96” OLED display (410 x 502px) and a 470mAh battery that should last up to 18 days. The watch measures 39.4 x 44.5 x 9.9mm without the strap. The previous model, the Redmi Watch 5 Lite, measured 11.4mm thick and had the same battery capacity. The body is rated for 5 ATM of water resistance and uses a proprietary charging connector. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, A08 and A07s surface on the Google Play Console
description: After clearing the FCC, the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is now past another major hurdle – it is now listed on the Google Play Console. Two entry-level models joined it, the Galaxy A08 and A07s. The Galaxy S26 FE specs leaked in detail last week. The console confirms the chipset as S5E9955, aka the Exynos 2500. The phone (SM-S741U) is configured with 8GB of RAM and a 1,080 x 2,340px display as expected. Samsung Galaxy S26 FE image and specs from the Google Play Console The GPC offered one image of the phone, but you can see more of the Galaxy S26 FE in these leaked renders, which...

title: Samsung partners up with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, here's what that means
description: Today, Samsung has announced that it is the official partner of the upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. The game is due to be released on October 23. Samsung is "the official TV, monitor, soundbar, and Wi-Fi speaker partner" of the game. In practice, this means that the game will support Samsung's HDR10+ Gaming format, which "helps deliver more accurate color and contrast, supporting the immersive visual experience that reflects the creative intent of the developers", according to the company. Additionally, the game will support the 32:9 aspect ratio of Samsung's Odyssey G9...

title: Huawei schedules launch event for September 2
description: Huawei will be holding its next product launch event on September 2 in Munich, Germany. The keynote features the “Chase the wild” tagline, and we’re expecting to see the latest crop of wearables from the brand. Huawei recently unveiled the Watch GT 7 series in China so it seems like the perfect time to bring the Watch GT 7 and GT 7 Pro to the global stage. Huawei has historically also introduced new wireless earbuds alongside its smartwatches, so we’ll have to wait and see if that will be the case this time.

title: Samsung will release 5 new foldables next year, claim insiders
description: The Galaxy Z Fold8 was such a success out of the gate that Samsung increased the production target for this year by 1 million units. And that’s not all – Samsung will launch two wide foldables next year, claim insiders who spoke to ETNews. This means that the Galaxy Z9 generation will have a total of five members. No, we didn’t miscount: 1) the wide Z Fold9, 2) a second wide foldable, 3) Z Fold9 Ultra, 4) Z Flip9 and 5) a new Galaxy Z TriFold. title: Honor Turbo 5G makes surprise appearance ahead of official launch
description: Back in May, Honor unveiled its Win Turbo phone with a massive 10,000mAh battery and a listing on AliExpress has revealed a new Turbo member. The Honor Turbo 5G is a familiar-looking device, sharing the same design as the X80 Pro Max but with different specs. Honor Turbo 5G Turbo 5G is equipped with a 6.79-inch AMOLED with 1,200 x 2,640px resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It also features an 8,560 mAh battery with 80W wired charging and IP69K ingress protection. The phone boots MagicOS 10 based on Android 16. There’s a Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 under the hood, which is paired with...

title: HMD 2760 Flip design and key specs leak, said to run Android 13 Go
description: HMD unveiled the 2660 Flip feature phone at MWC in March last year. The company now appears to be preparing its successor, the 2760 Flip, which is tipped to run Android. According to a new leak, the HMD 2760 Flip will run Icon OS 13, which is based on Android 13 Go. This would mark a big change from its predecessor, which ran KaiOS. It also means that users will have access to the Google Play Store. The 4G flip phone is tipped to feature a 2.8-inch main LCD display and a 1.77-inch outer screen. It is expected to be powered by the Unisoc T310 chipset, paired with 2GB of RAM and 32GB...

title: CUBOT Teases KINGKONG Dura, a Rugged Phone Built Around Swappable Battery Power
description: CUBOT is preparing to unveil the KINGKONG Dura, a rugged smartphone built around a practical replaceable-battery system designed to reduce charging downtime and keep users moving. Instead of connecting the phone to a charging cable and waiting, users can remove the depleted battery, install a fully charged spare, and quickly return to work, travel, or outdoor activities. It is a straightforward approach to mobile power created for people whose days cannot always pause for charging. title: Poco M8x to be powered by Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC, key specs and pricing tipped
description: Poco recently began teasing the M8x 5G's launch in India. While the company has yet to reveal details about the upcoming phone, a teaser on Flipkart has confirmed the chipset powering the handset and its launch date. A tipster has also leaked several other key specs and pricing details. According to the Flipkart teaser, the Poco M8x will launch in India on August 21 and come equipped with the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset. However, tipster Yogesh Brar claims the handset will instead feature MediaTek's Dimensity 6300 SoC. Brar also claims that the handset will sport a 6.9-inch LCD...

title: Tipster claims Xiaomi 18 Ultra cancelled, upcoming vivo and Oppo Ultras won't go global
description: The Xiaomi 18 Ultra, which was rumored to debut in December this year, has reportedly been cancelled. According to a new leak, Xiaomi will launch only three smartphones as part of its upcoming 18 series. In a post on X, tipster Kartikey Singh claims that Xiaomi will not launch an 18 Ultra this year. According to the tipster, the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max will instead sit at the top of the company's upcoming flagship lineup. However, this does not necessarily mean Xiaomi has abandoned the Ultra model altogether and we could see a Xiaomi 17 Ultra successor next year. The company is likely...

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 series tablets now appear in Google Play Console's supported devices list
description: The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 series tablets were recently spotted on Bluetooth SIG's website, as they were Bluetooth-certified. Now those same tablets have appeared in Google Play Console's supported devices list. The Galaxy Tab S12 series consists of two tablets - the Galaxy Tab S12+ and the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. The Google Play Console lists five models of the Galaxy Tab S12+ and three models of the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. title: Pixel 11 series, Honor Robot Phone, Redmi 17 official, Week 33 in review
description: Tech news started picking up a bit, especially in the past week. Google unveiled its Pixel 11 series alongside the Pixel Watch 5. The Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, and 11 Pro Fold all pack the new Tensor G6 SoC, which turned out to use a 3nm process after all, not the heavily rumored 2nm. The specs of the Pixel phones are mostly the same as their predecessors - the small Pro has a 6.3-inch display, the Pro XL a 6.8-inch one, but brighter.
